name: Workshop Foundry AI
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'if command -v mysql >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo mysql client already installed; else if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then APT="apt-get"; elif command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1; then APT="sudo apt-get"; else echo mysql client install requires root or sudo; exit 1; fi; $APT update; INSTALLED=0; for PKG in default-mysql-client mariadb-client mysql-client; do if DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive $APT install -y $PKG; then INSTALLED=1; break; fi; done; if [ "$INSTALLED" -ne 1 ]; then echo failed to install a mysql client package; exit 1; fi; fi; python --version && az version && pwsh -v && mysql --version'
